A10 Default Signaling and Interoperability
A10.1 Interoperability principles


A10.1   Interoperability principles

                 The following interoperability principles apply to both AXI3 and AXI4 components.

                As a general principle, components must support all combinations of inputs, but do not have to generate all
                    combinations of outputs. For example, a slave must support all the different possible lengths of burst, but a master
                    only has to generate the types of burst that it uses. This policy ensures that all components work with all other
                   components.

                 The conditions under which a signal can be omitted from an AXI interface are:

                   Optional Outputs

                                              If a component might require a value that does not match the default value, then the component must
                                have the output signal present.

                   Optional Inputs

                         An input signal can be omitted if the master or slave does not need to observe the input signal for
